rule: Pits and nests are theme templates: a base family plus required and banned traits (for example all fire breathers, no cold), a ban list for unfair combinations, a level-sorted list of 16 members, and a per-square object chance. Friend groups scale with depth: group size is total times (depth minus monster level plus 5) divided by 10, with a probabilistic extra from the remainder, and no group at zero or below. Vault and room stamps use per-cell probabilities (monster 50 percent, object 25 percent, trap 6.25 percent). Level profiles aim for a room count with a rarity cap and a cutoff per room row. All numbers are donor values, kept as data fields with null donor value because the donor is dual GPL or Angband-licence code.
keep: theme filter as the pit identity: one base, one required trait, one banned counter
ban list for unfair combinations such as no slow or confuse in a swarm
depth-scaled group size so one row yields several zones
per-cell probability table in stamps as the walk-density knob
rarity plus cutoff rows for room placement
change: 16-member pits become 3 active attackers plus a queue
donor names and monster rows are replaced by our 100 Pit characters tagged by theme
donor legacy palette and flicker cycle are out of scope
suffix tags in room names are not carried over
look_test: One stub room per theme at 375 wide: a fire hall (all fire breathers, no cold), a crawler swarm (no slow), an animal den. Walk in and judge: theme readable from the door, crowd feels like one thing, three attackers at a time feels right. Then show 2 active and 4 active and pick.

Assets class A/C per AU004; not used. Inspiration category-level only; no pit names, monster rows, vault maps or room names copied. No legal conclusions.
not_read: vault.txt layouts beyond one sample (Birds of a feather) and vault legend beyond the first symbols
monster.txt friends role suffix values (header says roles exist; not counted)
lib/sounds and sound.prf (ambience by depth not verified here)
rating-0 flag checked only for the first 15 of 66 interesting rooms
no server half found in top-level listing; not searched further
'-DRL' and '-ES-' room name suffixes not explained in files read
no per-level monster count or 20-second walk figure found in parts read
